title: Vendor return part search without View shows the access error
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Needs: 2 users (Admin, user without Inventory View) · 2 browsers · about 15 minutes
  • Build: the Part Lifecycle QA build (no build exists yet; use the build named in the test run).
  • User: [Admin] = you, signed in with the Admin role, which by default has 'Part Library & Inventory → View / Create & Edit / Delete' and See Financial Data.
  • User: [User-B] = a staff member whose custom role [Role-B] can create vendor returns but has every 'Part Library & Inventory' box unticked.
  • Location: [Loc-1] = the location picked in the top-bar location switcher at the start; every step runs at [Loc-1] unless it names another location.
  • Data: [Part-A] = tracked part from [Vendor-1], quantity 4, set inactive in Setup.
  • Names and numbers marked (e.g. …) are examples only. What must hold is the status (active or inactive), tracking, quantity and link described above.

Setup

  1. Go to Parts → Vendors, click "New Vendor", type Name (e.g. "ZZAUTOTEST PL RETNOVIEW Vendor"), click "Save & Close". [Vendor-1] = that vendor.
  2. Go to Parts → Inventory, click "New Inventory Part" and fill in Description (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST PL RETNOVIEW PART), Part Number (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST-PL-RETNOVIEW-01), Category (e.g. Uncategorized), Cost (e.g. $10.00), Sell Price (e.g. $20.00), Vendor [Vendor-1]; leave "Track quantities and cost of goods" on; set the default bin's Quantity to 4; click Save.
  3. [Part-A] = the part number you typed (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST-PL-RETNOVIEW-01); [Desc-A] = the description you typed (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST PL RETNOVIEW PART).
  4. Go to Settings → Roles & Permissions, click "Create custom role", skip the template, name it (e.g. "ZZAUTOTEST PL RETNOVIEW"), turn on the Parts department with the vendor and returns permissions needed to create a return, and leave every 'Part Library & Inventory' box unticked, click Save. [Role-B] = that role.
  5. Go to Settings → Staff, add a staff member (e.g. first name "ZZAUTOTEST", last name "PL RETNOVIEW") with an email address you can open, Role [Role-B]; save, open the invite email and set a password. [User-B] = that user.
  6. Set [Part-A] inactive: on the Active tab search [Part-A], click its row, pick Part Status "Inactive", click Save, leave the note empty and click "Deactivate" in the "Deactivate part?" confirmation.
  7. Check the setup worked: in browser 2, signed in as [User-B], Parts → Returns opens the "Create Return" page. As [Admin], typing ZZAUTOTEST-PL-RETNOVIEW on that page offers [Part-A].
custom_steps:
1. In browser 2 (as [User-B]) go to Parts → Returns and start a new return ("Create Return").
  2. Pick Vendor [Vendor-1].
  3. Type "ZZAUTOTEST-PL-RETNOVIEW" in the Part Number lookup.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 3: No parts are listed and the application's standard access error message shows (the same message the application shows for any page or action the user has no access to).

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10822 (Story 9, Inactive Parts Cannot Be Added to New Work); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v26 (Ready for dev), S9-N3, read 8 Oct 2026; design canvas none. Source-verified 8 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S9-N3: “Picking parts on a vendor return or a vendor credit needs the 'Part Library & Inventory → View' permission, as it does today. Without it the part search there shows the standard access error.”
